data.name: Vespasiano
data.gender_notes: Vespasiano is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin word 'vespa', meaning 'quiet' or 'restful'. In ancient Rome, the name Vespasian was given to a child born during a peaceful time or to bring peace to a household. The name Vespasiano carries the meaning “Quiet or Restful” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Latin. Parents who choose Vespasiano usually hope their child will grow to embody quiet or restful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name reminding us to seek inner peace and tranquility.
data.etymology: Vespasiano belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Quiet or Restful.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Vespasiano total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_hebrew.long_meaning: From Hebrew וֶסֶף (vesef), 'to give, bestow', and יָנָה (yanah), 'God'. A name meaning 'God has given', 'God has saved'. This name is not found in the Bible.

in_greek.name: Vespasianos
in_greek.long_meaning: From the Greek ἵππος (hippos), 'horse', and σιον (sion), 'Zion'. A name meaning 'well-born, prosperous'. This name is not found in the Bible.

in_latin.name: Vespasianus
in_latin.long_meaning: From the Latin 'Vespasianus', derived from the Roman family name 'Vespasian', which is believed to be derived from 'vespa', the Latin word for 'wasp', and 'sianus', a surname of uncertain origin. A name meaning 'well-born, prosperous'. This name is not found in the Bible.

in_english.name: Vespasiano

data.cultural_impact: Vespasian was a Roman Emperor who, in AD 69, ended the tumultuous Year of the Four Emperors and ushered in the Flavian Dynasty. The name Vespasian has since been associated with peace, stability, and leadership.
data.spiritual_significance: From a Christian perspective, the name Vespasian carries a deeper spiritual meaning. In the Bible, the term 'rest' is often used synonymously with 'salvation' or 'redemption'. Thus, Vespasiano can be seen as a reminder of the peace and rest that comes through faith in God, who offers salvation and redemption to all.
